structure.layout: Three-column app layout: a left sidebar with global nav and a sign-in prompt, a middle column listing settings categories with chevrons, and a right content pane with stacked setting sections. Page is centred at about 1200px and the sidebar is separated by a hairline divider.

aesthetics.typography: System UI stack (-apple-system) everywhere: logo wordmark, nav, headings, body and buttons
aesthetics.typeScale: Small, flat scale: 23px logo, 17px sidebar nav, 15px settings headings (h2 semibold) and body, 13px helper text, 11px small 'Aa'. Action buttons are bold 15px. Little size contrast; hierarchy comes from weight and color.

notes: Elk (Mastodon client) Interface settings. One user-selectable accent color (default amber/brown, shown as #cc7d24 and darkened in light mode) drives every accent: the active category, the Sign in button, chip icons and text, and button outlines. Picking another swatch recolors the whole UI right away (checked live). Signed-out state: most sidebar destinations are dimmed grey and only Explore/Local/Federated are full contrast. Controls are 1px #eeeeee-bordered boxes with a 3.75px radius on a #fafafa background, with no shadows. In the Bottom Navigation chips, unselected items show the accent color and selected ones (Explore, Local, Federated, More menu) turn grey. A preview strip above the chips shows the chosen icons and adds one when a chip is toggled (checked live). Save is disabled until something changes. A 1px vertical divider separates the left sidebar from the settings columns.
